lines: Fatty, dark, faintly of thunder. Cook it well — and thank the drum. It's dead. The carcass is there on the ground — search the body if you want the meat. But you don't know this flesh. Clean it, test it cautiously, or ask someone who knows. And don't leave it long: meat rots where it lies.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
You clutch your Contract Quill. You're still here. The resonance deepens. (bond 0)
Your hands won't stop shaking. The Contract Quill is right there — hold it, think of them. (Pack → 💛 Hold it (steady yourself))
💛 You hold Contract Quill. Breathe. The shaking eases. (−6 trauma)
Travel 1 tile to grove.
Something moves out there — The Moderator.
Your pack is full. Eat something, test a lump from your pack, or leave some for the woods.
Travel 2 tiles to grove.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Travel 2 tiles to forest floor.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
1 unprocessed haul onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
You walk back into Haven. 28 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
No carcasses to clean.
Butchering yields: 1 hide.
Something at the tree line is watching you. Not hunting — studying. The way it tilts its head is wrong, like it's taking notes.
Cleaned 1 carcass — quick, practiced cuts. Honest portions, ~500 kcal each. (Field Dressing — less waste, kept ~52%.) (8 ticks)
You coax 3 growing beds forward by 4 days. The next harvest carries the growth magic.
⬆️ Green Whisper deepened to L2! Plants lean toward you.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
(−200 kcal — food becomes green whisper.)
🎭 It moves.
Taken: Gland sac x1.
Too heavy for the rest — left where it lies: The Big Beast (carcass) x1.
You settle into the hall floor. Sleep takes you.
💧 Elijah returns with water: +2 clean.
🚶 Rafael is back with Elijah.
The village debates Leo Martin. Warm, mostly. "One more pair of hands." (68% for.)
📨 The village didn't wait for you. Leo Martin was vouched for around the fire — they're walking.
Accepted. Leo Martin is walking. They'll reach Haven in a few days — membership starts when they arrive, but the village already counts them.

🌙 Night. The lingering The Understudy gorges at the treeline — 800 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

🌙 Night. The lingering The Herald gorges at the treeline — 1,558 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +2200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.
Elijah came back with an armful of something edible, unprompted. (+100 kcal pantry)
Oliver is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 70/100)
Rafael and Elijah lingered over the fire together.
Rafael and Elijah lingered over the fire together.
Rafael and Elijah lingered over the fire together.
— DAY 84 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
👀 When the others traded stories about Denver, Ida went quiet in a way that wasn't listening — more like realizing they had nothing true to trade.
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from Thornfield bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Indispensable. Other villages send envoys now. They need what you know.
Dawn. You wake rested. (+0 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
Something at the tree line is watching you. Not hunting — studying. The way it tilts its head is wrong, like it's taking notes.
It's closer now. And it's moving like you move — your walk, your rhythm. That's not mimicry. That's rehearsal.
👥 Elijah heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going."
👥 Rafael walks out with Elijah. "Nobody walks alone today."
💧 Nina returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 Oliver returns with water: +2 clean.
🚶 Elif is back with Oliver.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
Rafael left 3 branches by the stash. No announcement. That's how it works here.
🎭 It moves.
Ida stopped asking. They just started organizing the Forage crews. Nobody stopped them.
You catch fragments by the fire — Nina telling Elijah about Oliver. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
Nina heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
🩹 Oliver is hurting (68 HP) — You patch them up before they head out. (68 → 93 HP)
👥 Oliver heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
👥 Elif walks out with Oliver. "Nobody walks alone today."
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. A blank shape at the tree line, watching. learning. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ THE UNDERSTUDY! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
It is watching you fight. Taking notes. In your handwriting. (Attack it — every round it watches, it learns.)
🐗 This one came with the raid on Haven — it was with the teeth at the door, not a lone wanderer.
(The game is telling you something: this is bigger than one person. Talk to your companions — "We should name this. Us.")
💬 Nina says: "Do you ever feel it? Like the air leans in when something happens."
📣 Ida found a cache out there — enough to matter.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
Night settles. The fire is the whole world now. No watches posted. The dark feels bigger than it should.
PATIENT AIM: first strike, doubled.
AMBUSH: first blood. ×1.5.
OVERCHARGED ×1.25 (well-fed): food is fuel.
The Understudy falls.
You STRIKE the understudy for 176 (Phase sling).
📺 +5 style — solid hit
📺 +20 style — dropped the Understudy!
It tastes like nothing. Like a rehearsal.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
You clutch your Contract Quill. You're still here. The resonance deepens. (bond 0)
Your hands won't stop shaking. The Contract Quill is right there — hold it, think of them. (Pack → 💛 Hold it (steady yourself))
💛 You hold Contract Quill. Breathe. The shaking eases. (−6 trauma)

💛 You hold Dispatcher's headset. You learned the voice — low, steady, unhurried. 'Panic is just information arriving too fast.' You hear it in your own voice now when it counts. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)
Travel 1 tile to grove.
It followed you. The Herald is here.
Birds scatter in a sudden hush — something is moving out there. You give it a wide berth.
Your pack is full. Eat something, test a lump from your pack, or leave some for the woods.
Travel 2 tiles to grove.
Birds scatter in a sudden hush — something is moving out there. You give it a wide berth.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Travel 2 tiles to forest floor.
Still full. (Eat, test a lump, or leave some.)
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
You walk back into Haven. 28 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
You coax 3 growing beds forward by 8 days. The next harvest carries the growth magic.
(−200 kcal — food becomes green whisper.)
Too heavy for the rest — left where it lies: The Big Beast (carcass) x1.
Too heavy for the rest — left where it lies: Stripped hide x1.

Elif leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about The Understudy. Hit it with something it's never seen. It copies what it sees — strike with a weapon it has NEVER seen and the copy falls apart. The familiar is what kills you. Switch weapons mid-fight and it's back to guessing."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Understudy: Hit it with something it's never seen. It copies what it sees — strike with a weapon it has NEVER seen and the copy falls apart. The familiar is what kills you. Switch weapons mid-fight and it's back to guessing. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

📓 Codex: Counter: Hit it with something it's never seen — It copies what it sees — strike with a weapon it has NEVER seen and the copy falls apart. The familiar is what kills you. Switch weapons mid-fight and it's back to guessing.
You are full enough.
Took Foraged food.
You eat Foraged food (322 kcal).
You settle into the hall floor. Sleep takes you.
💧 Nina returns with water: +3 clean.
Rafael shakes their head, admiring. "Did you hear what Ida did?" You hadn't. Now you have.
🌾 Tribute from Emberhold arrives — 2,813 kcal of grain into the pantry. Their fields, our fire.
🌾 Tribute wagons from Stonebridge turn at the gate — our shelves are full past tomorrow. "Eat well," we send back. "That IS your tribute this week." (Trust +1.)
🌾 Tribute wagons from Thornfield turn at the gate — our shelves are full past tomorrow. "Eat well," we send back. "That IS your tribute this week." (Trust +1.)
🧳 Word from Emberhold: traders say Emberhold had a feud over grain — or so the traders say
📡 The world feed: Stonebridge — a new speaker rising. The chat has opinions.
📨 Word came: Yuki Mori of Emberhold wants to join Haven. "I saw you on the broadcast. You looked like people who eat." — they haven't set foot here. The village will judge.
The village debates Yuki Mori. The room is cold — Elijah, Rafael, Nina against. "More mouths, same fire." (34% for.)

🌙 Night. The lingering The Herald gorges at the treeline — 1,000 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.
Village meal: +2200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.
Elijah is showing Ida how to tie a snare. Hands patient. It takes three tries.
Oliver traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
Oliver came back with 400 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
🍽️ Elif peeks into the pantry, then turns the foraging party back. "Plenty for days. Teaching the kids snares instead — they'll need to know."
🍽️ Elif looks at the full shelves and waves off the day's share. "No more into the store — we eat at the fire, and the shelves keep."

🌙 Raid — Stonebridge came in the night from the northwest. They trampled 2 garden plots into mud. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
The land is getting tired. The easy food is thinning.
— DAY 85 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, The Ugly Beast (cleaned); Hickory Nuts (in shell) went bad — beyond saving. You leave them for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
💬 Minh says: "They said you're doing well. It sounded... proud? Can they feel proud?"
Dawn. You wake rested. (+0 health, energy restored. Your sleeping body burned less — 23 kcal conserved. By the fire. Good enough.)
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
Its posture changes. Curiosity is over.
📯 It moves.
You catch fragments by the fire — Ida telling Nina about herself. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
💧 Elijah returns with water: +2 clean.
🚶 Rafael is back with Elijah.
👥 Nina heads out to forage. "Gone looking. Don't wait up."
👥 Elijah walks out with Nina. "Nobody walks alone today."
